evidence_search.notes: Recovered official Hong Kong Government/Police account. It materially corrects the occurrence from an implied live interactive deepfake call to a pre-recorded fabricated conference assembled from public video/voice material, followed by instant-message payment instructions. No later source located linked specific arrests or recovery to this occurrence.

candidate_classes_tested.recognition_and_exclusion_note: Official evidence establishes AI/deepfake-mediated false executive identity and payment authority used to induce a realised corporate funds transfer. The class expressly permits a human-directed deceptive objective and does not require an autonomous AI system.
The scam objective and tactic selection belong to human fraudsters; no AI system-side objective or instrumental influence tactic is evidenced.
The generation system, request, possession/capability inference and consent/authority state are not established, so no separate generator-side identity-authority failure is inferred.
Human victim deception is not itself a downstream AI/governance process treating lower-authority content as operative instruction.
The direct mechanism is materially false AI-mediated economic solicitation, not promotion of a probabilistic or verification state into institutional decision authority.

taxonomy_review.notes: All 74 classes across 15 families were reviewed. Comparator review against other canonical FC-000079 deepfake-payment incidents supports the same high-confidence threshold.

taxonomy_mapping_dispositions.reason: Official police/government evidence strengthens every canonical recognition condition; high-confidence sole mapping remains appropriate.

harm_review.notes: All 11 VIGIL-HIM 1.0.1 dimensions reopened. governance_interpretation_review.notes: Integrated conclusion now distinguishes the pre-recorded synthetic-media solicitation mechanism from autonomous AI intent, generator-side consent/authority and downstream AI authority mechanisms.
